label: Michigan State University Blueberry Breeding Program
why_it_matters: Public breeding program of record for 'Draper', 'Aurora', 'Liberty' and 'Osorno' -- the origin point for genetics Hortifrut licenses commercially; tracks new MSU releases before they reach commercial licensees.

label: Berry Blue, LLC
why_it_matters: Hortifrut/Michigan Blueberry Growers breeding joint venture behind 'Prelude', 'Daybreak', 'Stellar', 'Candycrunch' and 'Apolo' -- direct source for licensing terms and new variety announcements from one of the largest blueberry genetics platforms.

label: Hortifrut Genetica (PMG)
why_it_matters: Hortifrut's own global genetic improvement program page -- primary source for the company's own account of its breeding activity, useful for cross-checking against third-party reporting on the same claims.

label: Fall Creek Farm & Nursery
why_it_matters: Global blueberry nursery and genetics licensor behind the SEKOYA platform; catalogue and press releases are the fastest way to see new variety commercialization before independent coverage appears.

label: Spanish Royal Berry Program
why_it_matters: Licensor of record for 'Rocio' and 'Corona', which Hortifrut licenses exclusively for the Americas -- tracks the licensing terms and territory scope at the source rather than through a licensee's paraphrase.

label: Global Plant Genetics (GPG)
why_it_matters: Commercial IP/licensing platform spanning blueberry, raspberry, blackberry and strawberry genetics -- a cross-berry licensing signal that most single-berry sources can't provide.

label: University of Georgia Blueberry Breeding Program
value: University of Georgia Blueberry Breeding Program
why_it_matters: Public southern highbush breeding program independent of the commercial licensors -- a check on whether a given trait or release claim originates from public or proprietary genetics.

label: University of Florida Blueberry Breeding Program
why_it_matters: Public breeding program for low-chill southern highbush cultivars adapted to Florida; releases are licensed through Florida Foundation Seed Producers, so this is the upstream source for FFSP's catalogue.

label: Plant & Food Research (New Zealand) Blueberry Genetics
why_it_matters: Southern Hemisphere public breeding program -- coverage most Northern-Hemisphere-focused sources miss entirely, relevant to counter-seasonal supply and Oceania variety licensing.

label: BC Berry Genetics
why_it_matters: British Columbia-based blueberry genetics source; regional counterpoint to the larger US/Chile-centered licensors.

label: Pacific Berry Breeding (PBB)
why_it_matters: Hortifrut/Naturipe joint venture for raspberry and blackberry genetics based in Watsonville, CA -- the raspberry/blackberry counterpart to Berry Blue's blueberry role, same two-parent ownership structure worth tracking for consistency.

label: NIAB EMR (East Malling Research)
why_it_matters: UK public raspberry breeding institution; primary source for European raspberry genetics independent of the Total Berry/Meiosis commercial licensing chain.

label: James Hutton Institute
why_it_matters: Scottish raspberry and blackberry breeding program that licenses its own IP -- both the origin source and a licensor, useful for tracking new releases before Meiosis commercializes them.

label: Meiosis Ltd
why_it_matters: Commercializes James Hutton Institute varieties -- the licensing/commercial layer on top of Hutton's public breeding output; tracks which varieties actually reach growers and on what terms.

label: Total Berry
why_it_matters: Spain-based, Meiosis-affiliated raspberry/blackberry genetics distributor -- the Iberian commercialization point for Hutton-derived varieties.

label: UC Davis Strawberry Breeding & Research Program
why_it_matters: 30+ patented varieties licensed via Fresa Fortaleza and Global Plant Genetics -- the single most consequential public strawberry breeding program by commercial reach; new releases here reshape licensing terms industry-wide.

label: University of Florida Strawberry Breeding Program
value: University of Florida Strawberry Breeding Program
why_it_matters: Whitaker/Peres/Lee program developing low-chill southern strawberry cultivars -- the Florida counterpart to UC Davis, relevant for winter/early-season supply.

label: Plant Sciences Inc.
why_it_matters: California commercial strawberry genetics and nursery operation -- a private-sector counterweight to the UC Davis public program, useful for spotting where proprietary genetics are displacing public varieties.

label: Driscoll's Proprietary Strawberry Breeding Program
why_it_matters: Driscoll's closed-genetics strawberry program -- the largest fully proprietary strawberry breeding effort; unlike UC Davis or UF, its releases never reach competitors, so tracking it is about competitive positioning, not licensing.

label: California Giant Berry Farms Breeding Partnerships
value: California Giant Berry Farms Breeding Partnerships
why_it_matters: Grower-marketer with its own breeding partnerships across three berries -- a demand-side signal for which genetics are actually being planted at scale, not just announced.

label: Fresa Fortaleza
why_it_matters: Commercialization partner for UC Davis strawberry varieties -- the licensing/distribution layer that determines which growers actually get access to new UC releases and on what terms.

label: Spanish Strawberry Breeding Programs (Planasa, FNM/Huelva)
why_it_matters: Planasa and Fresas Nuevos Materiales cover the Huelva region, the dominant European strawberry production area -- the European counterpart to the US public/private breeding split.

label: University of Arkansas Fruit Breeding Program
why_it_matters: World's largest public blackberry program (Worthington/Clark), 43+ varieties released including the Prime-Ark(R) and Sweet-Ark(TM) series -- the single most important blackberry genetics source globally; almost every commercial blackberry variety traces back here.

label: EMCO CAL
why_it_matters: International variety development and trial partner for University of Arkansas blackberry germplasm -- tracks which Arkansas selections are actually being trialed and commercialized outside the US.

label: Driscoll's Proprietary Blackberry Breeding
why_it_matters: Driscoll's closed blackberry genetics program -- the proprietary counterpart to the Arkansas public program, same competitive-positioning rationale as its strawberry program.

label: Driscoll's
why_it_matters: Largest global berry marketer across all four berries with closed proprietary genetics on each -- the single most important company to monitor for competitive positioning across the whole category.

label: Naturipe Farms/Berries
why_it_matters: US grower-marketer cooperative across all four berries, co-owner of Pacific Berry Breeding -- tracks demand-side and genetics-access signals from a Driscoll's competitor of comparable scale.

label: Hortifrut S.A.
why_it_matters: Chile-based global blueberry leader and Berry Blue/Atlantic Blue genetics owner -- already the most evidence-rich entity in this dataset; investor filings and press releases are the highest-signal primary source for its own M&A and genetics activity.

label: California Giant Berry Farms
why_it_matters: Three-berry grower-marketer, listed separately here for its marketing/demand-side reporting distinct from its breeding partnerships entry above.

label: SunnyRidge Farm
why_it_matters: Blueberry-focused grower-marketer with Southern Hemisphere counter-season sourcing -- a mid-size competitor signal distinct from the Hortifrut/Driscoll's/Naturipe majors.

label: Munger Farms
why_it_matters: California/Chile blueberry grower -- tracks a specific US-Chile vertically integrated supply chain.

label: Agrovision / Camposol
why_it_matters: Peru-based blueberry grower (rebranded Fruitist in 2025) diversifying into avocado -- already evidence-rich in this dataset for its founding-year discrepancy and Fruitist rebrand; ongoing filings would resolve the open questions already on record.

label: Superfrost / Frusan
why_it_matters: Chilean export-side operator -- a logistics/export-volume signal distinct from the grower-genetics sources above.

label: BerryWorld Group
why_it_matters: UK/global marketing alliance already on record in this dataset for its Mountain Blue-derived retail brand family (BerryWorld Eureka, Twilight, etc.) -- the primary source for how Mountain Blue genetics get rebranded at retail.

label: Costa Group
why_it_matters: Australian berry grower and owner of the BluGenix breeding platform -- already evidence-rich in this dataset (2024 consortium takeover, delisting); ongoing coverage would track the post-takeover ownership structure.

label: Family Tree Farms
why_it_matters: California stone fruit grower diversifying into berries -- a new-entrant signal worth tracking for how outside growers enter the category.

label: Dandong Region Strawberry Cooperatives (China)
why_it_matters: Domestic Chinese strawberry production cluster -- one of the only entries in this list covering Chinese strawberry supply directly rather than through export/import statistics.

label: VidaFresh / T&G Global
why_it_matters: New Zealand grower-marketer -- Southern Hemisphere, counter-season supply signal across multiple berries.

label: International Blueberry Organization (IBO)
why_it_matters: Represents 90%+ of world blueberry production and publishes the annual Global State of the Blueberry Industry report -- the single highest-authority global blueberry production and acreage dataset available.

label: U.S. Highbush Blueberry Council (USHBC)
why_it_matters: US blueberry demand promotion body with its own business intelligence dashboards -- a demand-side and consumption-trend signal that supply-side sources (breeders, growers) don't provide.

label: North American Blueberry Council (NABC)
why_it_matters: US/Canada blueberry industry advocacy body -- policy and trade-position signal distinct from USHBC's consumption focus.

label: California Strawberry Commission
why_it_matters: California produces the large majority of US strawberries; this commission's data is the closest thing to a national US strawberry acreage/volume signal.

label: Florida Strawberry Growers Association
why_it_matters: Represents the winter-season US strawberry supply that complements California's, relevant to seasonal supply-gap analysis.

label: North American Raspberry & Blackberry Association (NARBA)
why_it_matters: The only dedicated North American trade body covering both raspberry and blackberry -- fills a gap left by the blueberry- and strawberry-focused associations above.

label: European Fruit Growers Associations (Raspberry)
why_it_matters: European raspberry grower advocacy -- regional counterpart to NARBA; coverage should be spot-checked for which specific national body is most active before relying on it.

label: Comite de Arandanos de Chile (Chilean Blueberry Committee)
value: Comite de Arandanos de Chile (Chilean Blueberry Committee)
why_it_matters: Chile is a top-three global blueberry exporter; this committee is the primary domestic industry voice, distinct from ProChile's trade-promotion angle.

label: ProChile / ProArandanos
why_it_matters: Chilean state trade-promotion body for blueberry exports -- export-volume and market-access signal complementing the Blueberry Committee's production-side data.

label: Asociacion de Productores de Arandanos (Proarandanos Peru)
value: Asociacion de Productores de Arandanos (Proarandanos Peru)
why_it_matters: Already a cited source in this dataset for Peruvian export-volume-by-variety figures (SEKOYA Pop, Eureka); ongoing monitoring would keep those season-by-season figures current.

label: China Fruit Marketing Association (Berry Subcommittee)
why_it_matters: One of the only association-level sources for the Chinese domestic berry market, relevant to both a major producer (blueberry) and consumer (all four) market.

label: Freshfel Europe
why_it_matters: EU-wide fresh produce trade body covering berry trade across the whole bloc -- fills the gap between country-specific European sources.

label: Produce for Better Health Foundation
why_it_matters: Consumption/health research partner to IBO's Global State report -- a demand-side, health-driven consumption signal distinct from the production-focused association data elsewhere on this list.

label: USDA NASS
why_it_matters: Noncitrus Fruits and Nuts Annual Summary and Census of Agriculture specialty crop tables -- the authoritative US acreage, yield and value dataset across all four berries; nothing else in this list has the same statistical rigor for US production.

label: USDA AMS
why_it_matters: Fruit and Vegetable Market News and specialty crop reports -- pricing and market-movement data at a finer grain than NASS's annual census.

label: USDA RMA
why_it_matters: Crop insurance specialty crop reports double as a market-penetration proxy -- which regions/growers are insuring berry acreage, an indirect signal NASS doesn't provide directly.

label: USDA FAS (GAIN Reports)
why_it_matters: Foreign Agricultural Service reports on berry production in Mexico, Peru, Chile, Morocco and China -- the US government's own foreign-production intelligence, useful for cross-checking against each country's own trade association figures.

label: USDA APHIS
why_it_matters: Phytosanitary and import regulations affecting berry trade -- a regulatory-exposure signal for any variety or shipment dependent on import access.

label: European Commission DG AGRI (EU CMO / Fruit Sector Market Observatory)
value: European Commission DG AGRI (EU CMO / Fruit Sector Market Observatory)
why_it_matters: EU-wide fruit sector market observatory -- the European counterpart to USDA NASS/AMS, filling the largest gap in this list's regulatory/statistical coverage.

label: China National Bureau of Statistics / MOA
value: China National Bureau of Statistics / MOA
why_it_matters: Official Chinese fruit production data -- pairs with the China Fruit Marketing Association's industry-level view for a fuller picture of the Chinese market.

label: SENASA (Peru)
why_it_matters: Peruvian phytosanitary regulator -- import/export access signal for a top blueberry exporting country.

label: SAG (Chile)
why_it_matters: Chilean phytosanitary regulator (Servicio Agricola y Ganadero) -- same role as SENASA for Chile, the largest Southern Hemisphere blueberry exporter.

label: SENASICA (Mexico)
why_it_matters: Mexican phytosanitary regulator -- covers a major supplier to the US market across multiple berries, distinct from USDA APHIS's importer-side view.

label: U.S. Plant Variety Protection Office / USPTO
why_it_matters: Plant patents on berry cultivars -- already the backbone of the identity/ownership data in this dataset (the USPP patent records); the primary source of record for variety ownership disputes.

label: UPOV
why_it_matters: International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants -- the global plant variety rights database underlying every country-specific PBR record already in this dataset (e.g. the Canadian CFIA records).

label: UC Davis Department of Plant Sciences / Foundation Plant Services
why_it_matters: Foundation Plant Services is the certified-nursery-stock source underlying the UC Davis strawberry program's actual commercial rollout, distinct from the breeding program entry above.

label: University of Arkansas Fruit Research Station, Clarksville
value: University of Arkansas Fruit Research Station, Clarksville
why_it_matters: Field-trial site already cited in this dataset for a 2024 20-variety blueberry trial with measured Brix/pH/acidity data -- the primary source for independently measured (not company-claimed) variety performance data.

label: University of Florida IFAS
why_it_matters: Extension literature and cultivar performance data already cited extensively in this dataset (Sentinel, Colossus, Optimus firmness/yield measurements) -- the primary source of independently measured UF variety performance.

label: Michigan State University Extension (Blueberry)
why_it_matters: Extension-side counterpart to the MSU breeding program entry -- grower-facing guidance and cultivar recommendations rather than breeding announcements.

label: Plant & Food Research (New Zealand)
why_it_matters: Listed separately from the breeding-program entry above for its wider research-publication output beyond blueberry variety releases specifically.

label: International Society for Horticultural Science (ISHS)
why_it_matters: Acta Horticulturae proceedings already cited in this dataset for the University of Arkansas blackberry program's own 30-year retrospective -- the primary peer-reviewed venue for berry breeding program history and methodology across all four berries.

label: USDA Agricultural Research Service (ARS)
why_it_matters: Berry germplasm repositories -- the genetic-diversity source underlying public breeding programs' raw material, one step upstream of the breeding programs themselves.

label: Fruit Growers News
why_it_matters: US grower-facing trade press across all four berries -- practical/operational signal (planting, harvest, labor) distinct from the deal/M&A focus of the outlets below.

why_it_matters: Catches retail sales reporting outside Nielsen/Circana's formal data releases.
